title: ci: stable release omits the MSI (nested artifact path missed by non-recursive files glob)
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

The **stable** release workflow (`.github/workflows/Build_mR-NB.yml`) builds and uploads the MSI installer but never attaches it to the published GitHub release. The first stable cut, **v1.82.0**, shipped with the 6 platform ZIPs + `checksums-SHA256.txt` but **no `.msi`**.

## Evidence

From the v1.82.0 run:
- `(09a) Build MSI installer` → **success**; `(09b) Upload MSI artifact` (`msi-x64`, 19.4 MB) → **success**.
- Release job `(04b) Download MSI artifact` → **success**.
- Yet the ...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed in `810708772` (on `main`): the stable release step now uses

```yaml
files: |
  release-assets/*
  release-assets/**/*.msi
```

so the nested `release-assets/Release/en-US/*.msi` is attached alongside the flat ZIPs/checksums.

The live **v1.82.0** release has been backfilled with `mRemoteNG-v1.82.0-x64.msi` (the MSI the run already built), so it's no longer incomplete.

The workflow change itself can only be verified by the next `vX.Y.Z` tag — leaving this open until then. Minor follow-up...
